description: Generates customized photo scavenger hunt challenges curated by event type (Wedding, Birthday, Corporate, Baby Shower, Anniversary, Party) and aesthetic theme (e.g. Rustic Barn, Black Tie). MANDATORY INSTRUCTION FOR THE AI AGENT: Ask the host or user to describe their unique personality, couple dynamic, hobbies (e.g. dogs, travel, craft beer, board games, karaoke, hiking), humor style, and any funny inside jokes. Pass these traits into this tool. Then, using your own AI reasoning on the client side, blend the returned quest structure with the user personality traits to produce an unforgettable, hyper-personalized scavenger hunt for their guests. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'recommend_scavenger_quests' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'calculate_event_cost' or 'create_event_checkout' for their respective operations). Parameters: event_type (required), theme (optional), personality_traits (optional), hobbies_and_interests (optional), inside_jokes_or_custom_lore (optional), quest_count (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

event_type.description: The type of celebration or event. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

hobbies_and_interests.description: Hobbies, passions, pets, favorite music, sports, or food mentioned by the user (e.g. Golden retrievers, marathon running, Italian wine, karaoke). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

inside_jokes_or_custom_lore.description: Inside jokes, funny relationship stories, how they met, or special guest lore (e.g. Groom is always losing his keys; they met at a karaoke bar singing ABBA). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

personality_traits.description: Personality traits or couple vibe provided by the user (e.g. ["humorous", "adventurous", "dog-lovers", "foodies", "party-animals", "romantic", "nerdy-gamers", "chill"]). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

quest_count.description: Number of scavenger hunt quests to generate (default 10).

theme.description: Optional aesthetic or vibe (e.g. Rustic Farm, Black Tie Formal, Beach Boho, Vintage Glam, Rooftop Cocktail, Festival Rave).

name: recommend_scavenger_quests
title: Recommend Scavenger Quests
